02/10.02.2025 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Piparwar P.S. Case No. 24 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 376, 313 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of Sri S.S. Tirkey,
learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Chatra.
3. Marriage of the prosecutrix with the petitioner was arranged.
Subsequently, the petitioner threatened that he will not marry her unless she allowed him to have premarital sex.
Later on, the petitioner refused to marry her.
4. It appears that the petitioner has established physical relationship with the prosecutrix by fraud and coercion.
5. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am not inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.
